helpIntro.message: Click a section to expand it. "Open settings" jumps to the matching tab.

helpStartBody.message:
Open a regular web page and press **Let it snow!** — snow starts falling from the top. **Stop** removes it from the page.
• **Auto start** runs the snow on every new page and continues the snowfall where it was when you navigate.
• All settings are saved automatically.
• Snow does not work on browser system pages and extension stores — this is a browser restriction.

helpSnowBody.message:
The **Snow** tab sets the flake count (1–320), fall speed, minimum and maximum size (in % of the shorter window side) and the mouse reaction radius.
• **Auto (2D/WebGPU)** — the fast default mode: WebGPU, or Canvas 2D when WebGPU is unavailable.
• **Full 3D** — volumetric Three.js/WebGL2 flakes with perspective and tumbling. The **3D thickness** slider changes the extrusion depth.
• The glow follows the flake shape, twinkles and adapts to light or dark page backgrounds automatically.
• If 3D is slow, reduce the flake count and size or switch back to Auto.

helpSymbolsBody.message:
The **Symbols** tab controls how flakes look.
• **Colors** — the palette for text symbols.
• **Symbols** — any characters and emoji. The mode button switches between **text** (tinted with the palette) and **emoji** (keeps its own colors, e.g. 🦖). The mode is detected automatically.
• **Phrases** — falling text; their count is set separately.
• **GIF** — by HTTPS URL or from a local file. GIFs get depth in 3D and a glow in the colors of their edges.

helpWindBody.message: On the **Wind** tab enable wind and choose the direction (left, right, random), strength and gust frequency. Small flakes drift more; strong wind adds lift and vortices.

helpPresetsBody.message:
A preset chosen in the list is applied **immediately**, including a snowfall that is already running.
• Edits are not written into the preset automatically: an "Unsaved changes" bar with a **Save** button appears.
• When switching presets with unsaved edits you can save them as a new preset, write them into the previous one, discard them or cancel the switch.
• **Load templates** restores the built-in presets (Winter, Spring, etc.).
• **Export/Import** — a JSON file; the "Transfer all presets" switch saves and loads all presets at once.

helpSyncBody.message:
Turn on **All tabs and windows** (the **API** tab) and start, stop and effects apply to every open tab of this browser. No relay is needed for that.
• Commands are synchronized, not exact flake positions.
• Hidden tabs pause the animation.

helpRelayBody.message:
The relay is a small local program that links Chrome, Firefox, Edge, OBS and external programs **on the same computer**.
• Download the ready-made `let-it-snow-relay` app from GitHub releases (no Node.js required) or run `pnpm relay` from the sources.
• In every browser, on the **API** tab, enter `ws://127.0.0.1:8787/ws` and the same **token** shown in the relay window, then enable **Connect to relay**. The status should become "connected".
• The relay only accepts connections from this computer (127.0.0.1).

helpPageApiBody.message:
A trusted website can control the snow in its own tab without the relay.
• Enable **Allow commands from pages** and list exact origins, e.g. `https://dashboard.example.com`, one per line.
• The site sends `window.postMessage({target: "let-it-snow-api", command: "burst", params: {count: 250}}, location.origin)`.
• The command affects only that site's tab. Allow only websites you trust.

helpSecurityBody.message:
• The extension does not collect or share personal data; there is no analytics or tracking.
• External commands are validated and limited in size, count and duration.
• The relay is reachable only from this computer and requires a token. Do not publish the token or the OBS link — they grant control over the snow.
• The token is kept only in local browser storage and is never synced.

helpTroubleBody.message:
• **No snow** — open a regular (non-system) web page and reload it.
• **Relay does not connect** — check that the relay is running and the address, port and token match.
• **Command accepted but nothing happens** — check `delivered`, the connection status and that the tab or OBS source is visible.
• **Error 401** — wrong token; **429** — commands are sent too often.
• **3D is slow** — reduce the flake count or choose Auto mode.
